name: Taveuni
tagline: Fiji's garden island, with rainforest waterfalls and the 180th meridian
description: Taveuni is a rainforest island known as Fiji's garden island, crossed by the 180th meridian. Trails lead to the Bouma waterfalls, whose lower fall is over 30 m high, along the Lavena Coastal Walk, and up 1,195 m Des Voeux Peak. Lake Tagimaucia, a crater lake at about 830 m, is where the tagimaucia, Fiji's national flower, grows, and it grows only on Taveuni. Offshore, Rainbow Reef in the Somosomo Strait is a 32 km soft-coral reef with over 30 dive sites.
whyVisit: Hike to rainforest waterfalls and pools
Climb to crater lakes and peaks

goodToKnow.title: Carry cash for park fees
goodToKnow.detail: Bouma costs about FJD 50 and the Lavena Coastal Walk about FJD 35, both cash only. Fees have changed over the years, so confirm locally.

goodToKnow.title: Lake Tagimaucia is a long hike
goodToKnow.detail: The guided hike takes about eight hours return, and the tagimaucia flowers from October to December.

goodToKnow.title: Book Waitabu ahead
goodToKnow.detail: Waitabu Marine Park is visited on guided tours that must be arranged in advance, from about FJD 20 to 40 a person.

bestTimeBlurb: {months} suit waterfall hikes and diving the Somosomo Strait. Cyclones can occur Nov to Apr.
